name: Smoky Tempeh Fajitas with Peppers, Onions & Avocado

instructions.primary_message: Place oil and spices in a large bowl. Stir to combine the spice paste.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp chili powder
1 tbsp smoked paprika
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slice tempeh crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces. Add to the bowl with the spice paste, gently stir to coat, and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 green bell peppers
3 yellow bell peppers
1 ½ limes
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the tempeh.

Peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into ½-inch thick half-moons. Add to the bowl and gently stir once more to combine. Divide tempeh and veggies between two large baking sheet pans and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until tempeh is browned and veggies are fork-tender, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, cut limes into wedges. Set aside for serving.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Set aside.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates, then fill with tempeh, veggies, and avocado. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and enjoy!
